goserve-wf-short-specs.title: 06 · Review a service request
goserve-wf-short-specs.heading: Review your request
goserve-wf-short-specs.body: Check the selected service, requirements and fee before submitting.

fields.label: Fee
fields.value: Free or the selected type’s configured amount

fields.label: Details and evidence
fields.value: Your entered details and required files

notes: The server validates the current fee and requirements. Pending declaration blocks submission. Repeated taps create one reference.
Paid requests use eGovPay or teller-confirmed cash; processing starts after authoritative payment. Office receives a committed submission live.

goserve-wf-short-specs.title: 07 · Ready for physical pickup
goserve-wf-short-specs.heading: Ready for pickup
goserve-wf-short-specs.body: Claim this request to get your pickup code.
notes: Office marks Ready → this student screen updates live. Ready alone generates no QR.
Claim checks ownership, status and payment. An unconfigured expiry or failed check leaves the request Ready with retry.

goserve-wf-short-specs.title: 08 · Student pickup QR
goserve-wf-short-specs.heading: Show this at pickup
goserve-wf-short-specs.body: Staff reviews your code and confirms the handover.
notes: Claim generates or retrieves one valid server code. Reopening reuses it until expiry or invalidation.
Scan or manual entry → authorized office review → explicit handover confirmation → Completed on both sides live.

goserve-wf-short-specs.title: 09 · Digital document receipt
goserve-wf-short-specs.heading: Your PDF result
goserve-wf-short-specs.body: Download the released PDF, then confirm receipt.
notes: Office verifies/releases the PDF → student receives Ready for Download live.
Confirm receipt enables only after successful download of the released version. Confirmation completes both sides; failed download does not.

goserve-wf-short-specs.title: 13 · Authorized office workspace
goserve-wf-short-specs.heading: Manage your office
goserve-wf-short-specs.body: Review assigned work and update students in real time.

fields.label: Inbox and consultations
fields.value: Reply to inquiries · manage permitted schedules

notes: Committed submissions and inquiries arrive in the assigned office’s queue/inbox live.
Staff processes eligible requests and marks physical results Ready or releases verified PDFs. Faculty/Guidance manage their schedules; CCS secretary has assigned coordination access.

goserve-wf-short-specs.title: 14 · Office confirms handover
goserve-wf-short-specs.heading: Review before handover
goserve-wf-short-specs.body: Check the matching request before handing over the result.

fields.label: Pickup validation
fields.value: Eligible code · scan or manual entry

notes: Scanning only validates. The authorized office confirms the actual handover.
Server consumes the code and completes once. Wrong-office, expired, used or invalid codes are rejected. Completion updates student and office live.

goserve-wf-short-specs.title: 15 · Cashiering payment confirmation
goserve-wf-short-specs.heading: Review cash payment
goserve-wf-short-specs.body: Check the request and received amount before confirming.
notes: Only an authorized teller confirms the exact amount once. Student and responsible office update live.
Free requests skip payment. eGovPay uses trusted callback/reconciliation after contract approval; browser return never proves payment.

goserve-wf-short-layout.title: 01 · Create an account, then sign in
goserve-wf-short-layout.summary: First-time email: Terms → credentials → complete profile → account created → explicit Sign in. First-time Google: Terms → TIP Google → same profile → Home.

panels.title: 01 · Sign in
panels.notes: Email/password or TIP Google. Forgot password opens recovery. A valid, complete restored session goes directly to Home.

panels.title: 02 · Accept Terms
panels.notes: First-time users agree before continuing. Store the accepted version and server timestamp; returning completed users do not repeat unchanged Terms.

panels.title: 03 · Choose credentials
panels.notes: Email supports student1@demo.com. Password: at least six characters with a letter, number and symbol. Confirmation must match before the profile step.

panels.title: 04 · Complete student profile
panels.notes: All personal, academic and contact fields. No middle name is an explicit exception. Email creation ends with confirmation → Sign in; Google profile save ends at Home.

goserve-wf-short-layout.title: 02 · Submit a request and claim a physical result
goserve-wf-short-layout.summary: Submit → server records one reference → optional authoritative payment → office processing → office marks Ready → student Claim request → pickup QR.

panels.title: 05 · Student Home
panels.notes: New accounts have no invented activity. Browse Registrar, Student Accounting, Cashiering, Guidance and CCS across Casal and Arlegui.

panels.title: 06 · Review and submit
panels.notes:
The server validates the current fee and requirements. Pending declaration blocks submission. Repeated taps create one reference.
Paid requests use eGovPay or teller-confirmed cash; processing starts after authoritative payment. Office receives a committed submission live.

panels.title: 07 · Ready: choose Claim request
panels.notes:
Office marks Ready → this student screen updates live. Ready alone generates no QR.
Claim checks ownership, status and payment. An unconfigured expiry or failed check leaves the request Ready with retry.

panels.title: 08 · Present the pickup QR
panels.notes:
Claim generates or retrieves one valid server code. Reopening reuses it until expiry or invalidation.
Scan or manual entry → authorized office review → explicit handover confirmation → Completed on both sides live.

goserve-wf-short-layout.title: 03 · Digital results, consultations, inquiries and Seryo
goserve-wf-short-layout.summary: Digital delivery uses receipt confirmation. Consultations and office messages share live database records. Seryo remains a separate guidance conversation.

panels.title: 09 · Download and confirm receipt
panels.notes:
Office verifies/releases the PDF → student receives Ready for Download live.
Confirm receipt enables only after successful download of the released version. Confirmation completes both sides; failed download does not.

panels.title: 10 · Book a consultation
panels.notes: Choose Guidance or CCS faculty and an available slot. Atomic capacity prevents overbooking. Safe rescheduling preserves the original appointment if replacement fails.

panels.title: 11 · Student–office inquiry
panels.notes: Send → database commit → assigned office inbox updates live. Office replies appear here live. Read/unread state persists; retries preserve drafts and avoid duplicate messages.

panels.title: 12 · Seryo and inline attachments
panels.notes: Separate Allow/Decline consent. Plus: Attach a file / AI privacy. One PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB. Explain/Extract prepares an unsent draft. Context buttons navigate to Cashiering or an office. Provider gates and verified cleanup apply.

goserve-wf-short-layout.title: 04 · Office work, handover, Cashiering and settings
goserve-wf-short-layout.summary: Student, assigned office and authorized teller share Supabase records. Every relevant committed change appears on both authorized sides without manual refresh.

panels.title: 13 · Assigned office workspace
panels.notes:
Committed submissions and inquiries arrive in the assigned office’s queue/inbox live.
Staff processes eligible requests and marks physical results Ready or releases verified PDFs. Faculty/Guidance manage their schedules; CCS secretary has assigned coordination access.

panels.title: 14 · Confirm actual handover
panels.notes:
Scanning only validates. The authorized office confirms the actual handover.
Server consumes the code and completes once. Wrong-office, expired, used or invalid codes are rejected. Completion updates student and office live.

panels.title: 15 · Confirm cash payment
panels.notes:
Only an authorized teller confirms the exact amount once. Student and responsible office update live.
Free requests skip payment. eGovPay uses trusted callback/reconciliation after contract approval; browser return never proves payment.

panels.title: 16 · Settings and Terms
panels.notes: Every role has Settings, appearance controls and a Terms and Conditions button. Reading Terms does not record new consent. Sign-out clears account-scoped records and subscriptions.
